title: Reduced sea-ice grid labels are permitted by current CMIP7 guidance
status: WITHDRAWN — no erratum for parent-grid labelling
description: These hemisphere totals and strait transports carry the native sea-ice parent-grid label g118. The current CMIP7 guidance explicitly allows this for existing production, even though dedicated reduced-output grids are recommended for future work.
example: A hemisphere total has one value per month rather than a full map. Its hm branding and nh/sh region describe that reduction; g118 can legitimately identify the mesh used before the reduction. A reader should use those fields together.
scientific_evidence: The 23 November 2026 WCRP guidance permits parent labels for hm hemispheric means and ht sea-ice transects. Gadi checks of one header per all 16 versions confirm matching labels in attributes/DRS/filenames, hm or ht branding, nh/sh or glb regions, and the appropriate scalar or four-line dimensions. Native CICE T-grid and published full-grid siconc coordinate probes confirm the stated g118 parent in all eight experiments.
impact: The initial Medium classification is withdrawn. Dedicated labels can improve discovery and reduce checker warnings, but dimensional reduction alone does not make these existing labels incorrect under current guidance. No numerical payload validation is claimed by this check.
recommended_action: Do not retract or republish these 1,171 files solely for their parent-grid labels. Treat dedicated-grid work in PR #830 as a prospective improvement, and retain the separate ocean-path investigation in #864.
development_team_action: MOPPy/CMIP7 tooling: align recommendations and checker messaging with the accepted parent-label transition. No model-code correction or erratum is required for M01. The broader #827 ocean-path questions remain separate.
extent_statement: The 16-version / 1,171-file list records the reviewed inventory, not affected data or a withdrawal list. All filenames were reconciled; numerical data arrays were not read for this check.
publication_action: No withdrawal, retraction, replacement or ESGF submission performed by this task.
validation: All 16 representative headers and 1,171 filenames passed. Five native-versus-published grid coordinate probes for each of eight experiments agree within stored precision. No target data arrays were read; the evidence is about representation and parent-grid provenance.
